_doc: The Tern's flight under full assist (openspec/changes/flight-and-navigation section 4; built as far as openspec/changes/coop-drill design 2.1 needs: full assist only). Read by sc-core::combat. Axes ship-local: +X port, +Y dorsal, +Z bow; rates and accelerations are [yaw, pitch, roll]. Strafe set points (the helm's strafe pad) are held to strafe_max_mps and reached with tau_v_s (coop-drill design 2.1; FN section 4's RCS clamp is not the drill's yet); an attitude order is held inside held_deg turning slower than held_dps (FN 6a). EVADE throws new set points up to jink_mps either way every jink_period_s (the console mockup's numbers).
